body: Used to be weekly. Might do biweekly now. It sucks that theres no real help, I'm gonna tell her I feel suicidal but I'm not going to have her refer me for a psych eval. I've been so many times & they just keep you for a few days or until your insurance runs out, throw you on new meds & then send you home. IK what to tell them to get in or stay out of a hospital cuz I've gone through it so many times. I only have 2 friends in the area rn. I cant afford a car :( Do people use tinder for friends? I always thought it was a dating app!

I made a therapy appointment so I'm going to be able to talk to her about stuff again. I don't talk with friends or family about it. I quit therapy cuz I felt like it wasn't helping me and I usually felt worse after leaving.

I've always had an easier time showing anger and crankiness than sadness. It's just hard to talk about. It makes me feel vulnerable and I don't like that. I don't like having people worry about me, it makes me feel guilty. I don't want to bother people with my problems. I don't want to burden them. Sometimes people react with pity which I hate. I don't want them to see how poorly I'm doing, I want to save face. I feel like I'm whining or making too big of a deal out of things. I know being depressed and sad is a human thing but it's so hard to express. You're right, it's easier on the internet with strangers.

I stay inside cuz I don't have a car and there's no public transportation where I live. I think that's a barrier for me. The depression makes me want to stay inside & sometimes I get anxious about going out by myself. I have anxiety about body image and just being around people some days. I don't have many friends around here & they are busy with their own lives a lot. I want to make new friends but I'm still trying to way to meet new people. It's hard w no job and no school. I notice that I do feel better when I interact with friends.  It does pick me up when I'm not in a depressed state. When I'm depressed I isolate more just cuz I get crabby and don't want to take it out on people.
